text.tspan: 2024 United States Data Center Energy Usage Report
Figure 3.11. Average wattage of storage drives shipped in each year.
Network equipment is captured in two categories: ethernet switches and InfiniBand switches for
AI clusters. Shipment data for ethernet switches is obtained from IDC’s Network Equipment
Tracker in units of number of ports. These shipments are specified for ports of various speeds.
For the InfiniBand switches, we obtained data from IDC regarding AI equipment, which included
the number of switch units shipped in each year. Note that other internal network hardware for
AI, such as NV links, are considered part the AI server system and represented within the
Average power draw per ethernet port follows the estimates used in the previous report through
2020, then is held constant through 2028, as shown in Figure 3.12. For port speeds not present
in the previous report (100 Gb, 200/400 Gb, and 25/50 Gb speeds), wattage per power is
assumed to scale linearly with speed. InfiniBand switch units are assumed to operate at an
average of 700 W, based on the rated wattage values for 64-port units.
